Industrial work, public frontages, and restoration

Fence Wizards serves commercial and industrial projects in Columbus from Greenwood. Include the site address, ground conditions, and any limits on delivery access when requesting a quote.

Enclosing a working industrial site

A plant project may need contractor storage separated from ongoing operations. Tell us which entrances remain in use and which sides of the fence will stay fixed throughout the project.

Downtown work and urgent closures

Screen can reduce the view into a street-facing construction area. For storm or flood-related restoration, call with the location and the area that needs to be secured so Richard can discuss timing.

Choose the fence for your site

Panels & standsPost-driven chain linkWindscreenCrowd-control barricades

Choose portable panels for a changing layout, driven chain link for a fixed run, windscreen for privacy or graphics, and barricades for event queues. Richard can help combine them when the site needs more than one option.

Pricing and scheduling

The normal installation window is 24–48 hours. Call about urgent work and confirm the date for your project. The quote includes delivery, installation, the agreed rental term, and removal.

Standard rentals cover up to 12 months, with discounted rates for short jobs. Travel is accounted for in the quote. Send the full address, especially for a site near the edge of our roughly 80-mile coverage around downtown Indianapolis.
